name: manual_cfd6f2
claim: Before writing code around an external CLI or API, run its --version and --help and record the version and the defaults that act or spend; the Cline controller was built for months without ever reading Cline's help, which shows a bare prompt starts in act mode with tool auto-approval ON.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-10: help text read only after installing Cline 3.0.74; controller fixed in orama PR 487 commit e35d950c (plan mode, auto-approve off unless CLINE_ALLOW_ACT=1).
